newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ELECTRIC, ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY SEES GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ELECTRIC, ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY SEES GROWTH.

text.p: The Finnish electric and electronics industry on Monday released a new branch forecast predicting output growth of over 10 percent this year and next.

"Growth of over 10 percent is now expected for the years 1997-98," the branch federation said in a statement. "The value of production will rise from slightly over 50 billion markka in 1996 to 65 billion in 1998," it said.
Exports of electric and electronics industry products would increase quicker than production, the federation said. Between 1996 and 2002, exports would increase by 70 percent, it said.
In 1996, the value of the sector's exports was about 41 billion markka.
In 2002, exports would account for 85 percent of production, up from 75 percent in 1996, it said.
